runtime: ISO/IEC 9899:2024 C standard library (WG14 N3220 working draft)

official_documentation_checked.finding: The listed ISO C headers do not define a PNM image reader.
FILE, fopen and fread provide generic bytes but do not parse P1/P2/P3 headers or pixels.

limit: Scoped to ISO C; platform and third-party image packages are separate. No format-aware standard API exists to run on the control.
